fields.Name: Percent Off
fields.Description: A percentage off the line or order. Value is the fraction: 0.10 is ten percent.

fields.Name: Amount Off
fields.Description: A fixed sum off. On an order-level promotion this is allocated across lines pro-rata.

fields.Name: Override Price
fields.Description: Replaces the resolved unit price outright. Value IS the new price, not a reduction.

fields.Name: Free Shipping
fields.Description: Zeroes the shipping charge. Implemented as an adjustment against the shipping charge rather than by skipping it, so the waiver stays visible on the order.
